budget.formula: 36 direction singles + 10 remaining set images + 4 preview grids + 2 cross-SKU + 1 edit + 3 baseline controls = 56; 4 conditional reserve = 60
budget.counting_rule: Count every actual generation/edit dispatch, including failed, timed-out and rejected attempts. Unknown results stay charged; recover the same request before deciding any retry. One six-cell grid is one call and zero independent final images.
budget.accounting_note: Confirmed operator dispatches exclude SR-049, which failed before Send. Its reserved slot remains charged; SR-058 holds one possible automatic web call. The 60 ceiling was not exhausted; unavailable dependencies are not reassigned to unplanned retries.

pre_dispatch_checks: Freeze current commit, direction card hashes, source hashes, full compiled prompt and exact ordered attachments.
Bind missing fixtures before dependent requests; a pending item must not be silently replaced or marked pass.
Check existing authorization and remaining global count; reserve once before dispatch.
Each original source image role must be explicit. No preview grid as identity/garment evidence. Native attachment union must be <=5.
For a controlled pair, freeze shared inputs before either output is observed; never use the new output as the baseline identity reference.
execution_order: prompt-only dialogues on both routes (zero image calls)
remaining direction singles and their pre-frozen controls
SR-051 and SR-052 in new conversations
